plan.notes:
Per the 2026-2027 Texas A&M University undergraduate catalog: Philosophy (BA). Prerequisites are not listed in the catalog's plan of study grid; consult course descriptions.
Catalog footnotes:
[grid1 fn1] Complete 14 hours of a foreign language through the intermediate level. If you choose to enroll in a language you have studied previously without receiving college credit, you must first take a placement test. See academic advisor.
[grid1 fn2] Philosophy courses cannot be used to meet this requirement.
[grid1 fn3] Select from any 100-499 course not used elsewhere. Maximum of 3 hours of PHIL 484 may be used as general electives.
[grid1 fn4] To be selected in consultation with an advisor PHIL 100-499. At least four of the courses must be 300-400 level. Maximum of 3 hours of PHIL 484 may be used as Philosophy electives.
